stories.title: LeBron Stuns at MSG — 76ers Spoil Knicks' Championship Night 106-100

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LeBron James made sure the Knicks' championship night ended in a loss.

14 pts, 9 reb, 7 ast — and he even played center to neutralize KAT.

76ers 106, Knicks 100. The King is in Philly. 👑 #NBAOpeningNight

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Tyrese Maxey (28 pts) and a new-look 76ers squad spoiled New York's championship night in front of a sold-out MSG.

Philadelphia trailed by 10 in the first half, then outscored the Knicks 29-18 in the 3rd.

Statement win. #NBAOpeningNight #Sixers

article.headline: LeBron Stuns at MSG: 76ers Spoil Knicks' Championship Night 106-100

stories.title: Knicks' Bittersweet Night — Banner Goes Up, Opening Night Goes Away

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The banner is up at Madison Square Garden for the first time since 1973. ✨

New York Knicks NBA Champions. Whatever happens next, that doesn't go anywhere. #Knicks #NBAOpeningNight

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Jalen Brunson: 21 pts, 6-for-19 FG.
KAT: 19 pts, 12 reb — in 24 minutes of foul trouble.

The Knicks raised a banner and then dropped Game 1 of Year 2 to the 76ers. No. 1 target on the back. #Knicks

article.headline: The Banner Goes Up, the Game Goes Away: Knicks' Bittersweet Opening Night at MSG

stories.title: SGA Drops 32, Thunder Top Spurs 116-104 Without Holmgren

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
SGA put up 32 points against the team that knocked him out of the playoffs last spring.

Thunder 116, Spurs 104. Without Chet Holmgren. On Opening Night.

Message sent. 💪 #ThunderUp #NBAOpeningNight

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
The Thunder won Opening Night WITHOUT their No. 2 player.

Chet Holmgren (quad contusion) sat out. OKC beat the WCF champs anyway, 116-104.

This team is deeper than people think. #ThunderUp

article.headline: SGA Drops 32, Thunder Top Spurs 116-104 Without Holmgren — A Statement Win

stories.title: Pistons Come Back, Beat Celtics 121-113 in Opening Night Stunner

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
The Detroit Pistons came back from a double-digit deficit and stunned Paul George's new-look Boston Celtics 121-113.

Duncan Robinson was huge in the fourth quarter. Detroit is for real in the East. #NBA #Pistons

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Paul George's Celtics debut: a loss to Detroit on Opening Night.

Jayson Tatum struggled. Boston was outscored in the fourth quarter. The East is wide open. #Celtics #NBA

article.headline: Detroit's Statement: Pistons Come Back to Stun New-Look Celtics 121-113
